evaluator_agreement.how: uv run python results/autocorr3/arena_agreement.py (macOS arm64, numpy 2.5.3)
evaluator_agreement.result: evaluate.py is the arena verifier verbatim. On the five solutions it returns the arena's reported score bit for bit in two cases (2493, 2492) and one unit in the last place away in three (2510: 1.4508066395052837 vs 1.4508066395052834; 2491: 1.451593059911871 vs 1.4515930599118707; 2490: 1.4516035953026052 vs 1.4516035953026054). Largest relative difference 1.5e-16. numpy.convolve sums in a BLAS-dependent order, so the last digit is not portable; the exact rational values from verify.py are 1.4508066395052837, 1.451571863890207, 1.4515829477077313, 1.4515930599118707, 1.451603595302605.
